name: CKEditor 5 Custom Paste
description: A CKEditor 5 plugin that flattens content pasted into the editor to plain paragraphs, stripping inline and block formatting on paste; configured per text format.
project_description:
Introduction The CKEditor 5 Custom Paste module adds a CKEditor 5 plugin that rewrites content as it is pasted into the editor. When enabled on a text format, it intercepts the clipboard input transformation and flattens the pasted markup: every HTML tag is collapsed to a paragraph boundary (only
line breaks are kept), so inline formatting (bold, links, spans, fonts, colours, inline styles) and block structure (headings, lists, tables) are discarded and the text is delivered as plain paragraphs. Features Paste behaviour is a per-text-format configuration decision. Each CKEditor 5 text format gains a 'Ckeditor 5 Custom Paste' settings tab with an enable checkbox and an 'Excluded tags' field intended to name tags whose element should be preserved (with attributes stripped) rather than flattened. Post-Installation Post-installation, administrators navigate to the text format configuration page (Configuration > Content authoring > Text formats and editors), edit a CKEditor 5 format, tick 'Enable CKEditor5 custom paste', and optionally list excluded tags. The filter runs only when the checkbox is ticked. Additional Requirements Requirements include Drupal 9.3 or later and the core CKEditor 5 module. Note This is an editorial-hygiene / paste-cleanup helper that runs in the browser. It is not a security control; the security boundary for pasted markup is the text format's server-side filter chain (for example filter_html), applied on render regardless of how the markup entered the field.
